title: Make settings preview and replay read-only
summary: Separate settings authority reads from repair/projection writes, require complete review binding before durable replay classification, and restore production-faithful settings-store recovery evidence.
reason: Remediate P1 AUDIT-FIND-W02-002 and the directly coupled P2 findings AUDIT-FIND-W02-003 and AUDIT-FIND-W02-004. Preview and durable replay both claimed no-write outcomes while invoking persistence, and the Windows settings-store fixture obscured the affected recovery boundary.
affected_areas: settings save review confirmation and idempotent retry
behavior_before: Preview invoked the mutating authority loader, existing-store reads regenerated JSON/PSD1/projection/snapshots, durable replay bypassed complete review confirmation and called the saver again, and the direct Windows store suite used newline-translating and premature fault injection.
behavior_after: Preview and commit verification use an initialized read-only OS lock plus pure JSON/projection inspection; startup load remains the explicit repair/regeneration path. Durable retry requires every review field, validates request/candidate/base/preview binding, returns writes_config=false without saver or reload calls, and the Windows transaction fixture now uses production atomic byte semantics with late projection rollback evidence.
tests_added: Facade preview calls the pure authority reader and never the repair loader.
Durable replay performs no second authority save and rejects omission of each review-confirmation field plus tampered preview, base, review-entry, and changed-key evidence.
Pure authority reads preserve config, JSON store, projection, backup, snapshots, local mirrors, and lock bytes on read-only files; invalid JSON is blocked without last-good restoration.
Late projection-manifest failure occurs after store and PSD1 replacement and restores all three artifacts and snapshots without temporary residue.
Local API does not reload or claim a write for a durable no-write replay.
Productized HTTP smoke snapshots settings artifacts around preview and requires byte stability.

notes: High-risk settings persistence and strict-confirmation boundary. The required gate is command-contract review plus focused facade/store/Local API tests. No media policy, source mutation, or publish behavior changes; representative real media is not required.
